Alias.name: MCheckCommand
Alias.script: if MCheck and MCheck.command then MCheck.command(matches[2] or "") end

Script.name: MCheckMain
Script.script:
if type(MCheck) == "table" and type(MCheck.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(MCheck.shutdown) end
MCheck = { version = "0.2.2", protocol = "1", package_name = "mcheck", repository_id = "noobgonewild-mudlet-scripts", index_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Noobgonewild/Mudlet-scripts/main/mcheck-index.json", trusted_repositories = { ["noobgonewild-mudlet-scripts"] = { url_prefix = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Noobgonewild/Mudlet-scripts/main/", artifact_type = "xml", }, ["noobgonewild-mudlet-dinv"] = { url_prefix = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Noobgonewild/Mudlet-DINV/main/", artifact_type = "mpackage", filename = "DINV.mpackage", }, ["noobgonewild-mapper-and-s-d"] = { url_prefix = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Noobgonewild/Mapper-and-S-D/main/", artifact_type = "mpackage", }, }, scan = nil, rows = {}, transaction = nil, update_queue = nil, timer = nil, hash_job = nil, }
local MOD32 = 4294967296 local floor = math.floor
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
local function lower(value) return trim(value):lower() end
local OUTPUT_COLORS = { white = "ansi_white", cyan = "ansi_light_cyan", orange = "ansi_light_yellow", red = "ansi_light_red", green = "ansi_light_green", yellow = "ansi_light_yellow", light_grey = "ansi_white", dim_grey = "ansi_light_black", }
local function out(color, message) message = tostring(message or "") if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<ansi_light_cyan>[MCheck] <%s>%s\n", OUTPUT_COLORS[color] or "ansi_white", message)) elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[MCheck] " .. message .. "\n") end end
local function command_hint(label, command) if type(cecho) == "function" and type(echo) == "function" then cecho("<ansi_light_cyan>[MCheck] <ansi_light_yellow>" .. tostring(label) .. ": <ansi_light_green>") echo(tostring(command) .. "\n") else out("white", tostring(label) .. ": " .. tostring(command)) end end
local function scan_progress(position, total, addon_id) local progress = string.format("Progress %d/%d: ", position, total) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<ansi_light_cyan>[MCheck] <ansi_light_yellow>" .. progress .. "<ansi_white>checking " .. tostring(addon_id) .. "\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[MCheck] " .. progress .. "checking " .. tostring(addon_id) .. "\n") end end
local STATUS_COLORS = { ["[CURRENT]"] = "ansi_light_green", ["[UPDATE AVAILABLE]"] = "ansi_light_yellow", ["[LOCAL MODIFIED]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[LOCAL VERSION AHEAD]"] = "ansi_light_cyan", ["[NOT IN INDEX]"] = "ansi_light_black", ["[IDENTITY MISMATCH]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[NOT INSTALLED]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[PATH UNKNOWN]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[PATH IDENTITY MISMATCH]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[LOCAL FILE MISSING]"] = "ansi_light_red", ["[INVALID VERSION]"] = "ansi_light_red", }
local function status_line(index, row, available) local details = string.format("%d) %s %s -> %s ", index, row.addon_id, row.installed_version, available) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<ansi_light_cyan>[MCheck] <ansi_white>" .. details) cecho("<" .. (STATUS_COLORS[row.status] or "ansi_white") .. ">" .. row.status .. "\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[MCheck] " .. details .. row.status .. "\n") end end
local function read_file(path) local file, err = io.open(path, "rb") if not file then return nil, err end local content = file:read("*a") file:close() return content end
local function write_file(path, content) local file, err = io.open(path, "wb") if not file then return false, err end local ok, write_err = file:write(content) file:close() if not ok then return false, write_err end return true end
local function file_exists(path) local file = io.open(path, "rb") if not file then return false end file:close() return true end
local function path_key(path) path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("/+", "/") if package and package.config and package.config:sub(1, 1) == "\\" then path = path:lower() end return path end
local function basename(path) return tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/"):match("([^/]+)$") or "" end
local function dirname(path) return tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/"):match("^(.*)/[^/]+$") or "." end
local function ensure_dir(path) path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("/+$", "") if path == "" then return false end if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, path) end if type(lfs) ~= "table" or type(lfs.mkdir) ~= "function" then return true end local current, rest if path:match("^%a:/") then current, rest = path:sub(1, 3), path:sub(4) elseif path:sub(1, 1) == "/" then current, rest = "/", path:sub(2) else current, rest = "", path end for part in rest:gmatch("[^/]+") do if current == "" or current == "/" or current:match("^%a:/$") then current = current .. part else current = current .. "/" .. part end pcall(lfs.mkdir, current) end return true end
local bitlib = rawget(_G, "bit32") or rawget(_G, "bit") if not bitlib then local ok, loaded = pcall(require, "bit") if ok then bitlib = loaded end end
local SLOW_AND4, SLOW_XOR4 if not bitlib then SLOW_AND4, SLOW_XOR4 = {}, {} for left = 0, 15 do local and_row, xor_row = {}, {} SLOW_AND4[left + 1], SLOW_XOR4[left + 1] = and_row, xor_row for right = 0, 15 do local a, b, and_value, xor_value, place = left, right, 0, 0, 1 for _ = 1, 4 do local abit, bbit = a % 2, b % 2 if abit == 1 and bbit == 1 then and_value = and_value + place end if abit ~= bbit then xor_value = xor_value + place end a, b, place = (a - abit) / 2, (b - bbit) / 2, place * 2 end and_row[right + 1], xor_row[right + 1] = and_value, xor_value end end end
local function unsigned(value) return (tonumber(value) or 0) % MOD32 end
local function slow_bitop(a, b, mode) a, b = unsigned(a), unsigned(b) local result, place = 0, 1 local lookup = mode == "and" and SLOW_AND4 or SLOW_XOR4 for _ = 1, 8 do local anibble, bnibble = a % 16, b % 16 result = result + lookup[anibble + 1][bnibble + 1] * place a, b, place = floor(a / 16), floor(b / 16), place * 16 end return result end
local function band2(a, b) if bitlib and type(bitlib.band) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.band(a, b)) end return slow_bitop(a, b, "and") end
local function bxor2(a, b) if bitlib and type(bitlib.bxor) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.bxor(a, b)) end return slow_bitop(a, b, "xor") end
local function band(...) local values, result = {...}, MOD32 - 1 for i = 1, #values do result = band2(result, values[i]) end return result end
local function bxor(...) local values, result = {...}, 0 for i = 1, #values do result = bxor2(result, values[i]) end return result end
local function bnot(value) if bitlib and type(bitlib.bnot) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.bnot(value)) end return MOD32 - 1 - unsigned(value) end
local function rshift(value, count) if bitlib and type(bitlib.rshift) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.rshift(value, count)) end return floor(unsigned(value) / (2 ^ count)) end
local function rrotate(value, count) if bitlib then if type(bitlib.rrotate) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.rrotate(value, count)) end if type(bitlib.ror) == "function" then return unsigned(bitlib.ror(value, count)) end end value, count = unsigned(value), count % 32 if count == 0 then return value end return unsigned(rshift(value, count) + (value % (2 ^ count)) * (2 ^ (32 - count))) end
local function add32(...) local values, result = {...}, 0 for i = 1, #values do result = (result + unsigned(values[i])) % MOD32 end return result end
local SHA256_K = { 0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da, 0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967, 0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070, 0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2, }
local HEX = "0123456789abcdef"
local function hex_word(value) value = unsigned(value) local chars = {} for place = 7, 0, -1 do local digit = floor(value / (16 ^ place)) % 16 chars[#chars + 1] = HEX:sub(digit + 1, digit + 1) end return table.concat(chars) end
local function sha256_context(message) message = tostring(message or "") local byte_length = #message local bit_high = floor(byte_length / 536870912) local bit_low = (byte_length * 8) % MOD32 local function word_bytes(value) return string.char( floor(value / 16777216) % 256, floor(value / 65536) % 256, floor(value / 256) % 256, value % 256 ) end message = message .. string.char(128) local padding = (56 - (#message % 64)) % 64 message = message .. string.rep(string.char(0), padding) .. word_bytes(bit_high) .. word_bytes(bit_low)
return { message = message, offset = 1, h = {0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19}, w = {}, timer = nil, } end
local function sha256_process_block(context) local message, offset, h, w = context.message, context.offset, context.h, context.w for i = 0, 15 do local p = offset + i * 4 w[i] = message:byte(p) * 16777216 + message:byte(p + 1) * 65536 + message:byte(p + 2) * 256 + message:byte(p + 3) end for i = 16, 63 do local s0 = bxor(rrotate(w[i - 15], 7), rrotate(w[i - 15], 18), rshift(w[i - 15], 3)) local s1 = bxor(rrotate(w[i - 2], 17), rrotate(w[i - 2], 19), rshift(w[i - 2], 10)) w[i] = add32(w[i - 16], s0, w[i - 7], s1) end local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,hh = h[1],h[2],h[3],h[4],h[5],h[6],h[7],h[8] for i = 0, 63 do local s1 = bxor(rrotate(e, 6), rrotate(e, 11), rrotate(e, 25)) local ch = bxor(band(e, f), band(bnot(e), g)) local t1 = add32(hh, s1, ch, SHA256_K[i + 1], w[i]) local s0 = bxor(rrotate(a, 2), rrotate(a, 13), rrotate(a, 22)) local maj = bxor(band(a, b), band(a, c), band(b, c)) local t2 = add32(s0, maj) hh,g,f,e,d,c,b,a = g,f,e,add32(d,t1),c,b,a,add32(t1,t2) end h[1],h[2],h[3],h[4] = add32(h[1],a),add32(h[2],b),add32(h[3],c),add32(h[4],d) h[5],h[6],h[7],h[8] = add32(h[5],e),add32(h[6],f),add32(h[7],g),add32(h[8],hh) context.offset = offset + 64 end
local function sha256_result(context) local result = {} for i = 1, 8 do result[i] = hex_word(context.h[i]) end return table.concat(result) end
function MCheck.sha256(message) local context = sha256_context(message) while context.offset <= #context.message do sha256_process_block(context) end return sha256_result(context) end
local function cancel_hash_job() local job = MCheck.hash_job if job and job.timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, job.timer) end MCheck.hash_job = nil end
function MCheck.sha256_async(message, callback) cancel_hash_job() if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then callback(MCheck.sha256(message)) return end
local job = sha256_context(message) MCheck.hash_job = job local function step() if MCheck.hash_job ~= job then return end job.timer = nil local started = os.clock() repeat sha256_process_block(job) until job.offset > #job.message or os.clock() - started >= 0.006
if job.offset <= #job.message then job.timer = tempTimer(0, step) return end MCheck.hash_job = nil callback(sha256_result(job)) end job.timer = tempTimer(0, step) end
local function semver_parts(version) local major, minor, patch, suffix = tostring(version or ""):match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)(.*)$") if not major then return nil end return tonumber(major), tonumber(minor), tonumber(patch), suffix or "" end
local function compare_versions(left, right) local la,lb,lc,ls = semver_parts(left) local ra,rb,rc,rs = semver_parts(right) if not la or not ra then return nil end if la ~= ra then return la < ra and -1 or 1 end if lb ~= rb then return lb < rb and -1 or 1 end if lc ~= rc then return lc < rc and -1 or 1 end if ls == rs then return 0 end if ls == "" then return 1 end if rs == "" then return -1 end return ls < rs and -1 or 1 end
local function package_is_installed(name) if type(getPackages) ~= "function" then return true end local ok, packages = pcall(getPackages) if not ok or type(packages) ~= "table" then return true end for _, installed in pairs(packages) do if tostring(installed) == tostring(name) then return true end end return false end
local function hard_denied(addon_id, package_name, filename) return lower(addon_id) == "mcheck" or lower(package_name) == lower(MCheck.package_name) or lower(filename) == "mcheck.xml" end
local function fresh_id(prefix) return string.format("%s-%d-%06d", prefix or "mcheck", os.time(), math.random(0, 999999)) end
local function start_timer(seconds, callback) if MCheck.timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, MCheck.timer) end MCheck.timer = nil if type(tempTimer) == "function" then MCheck.timer = tempTimer(seconds, callback) end end
local function stop_timer() if MCheck.timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, MCheck.timer) end MCheck.timer = nil end
local function known_official_hash(entry, hash) hash = lower(hash) if hash == lower(entry.sha256) then return true end if type(entry.known_hashes) == "table" then for _, known in pairs(entry.known_hashes) do if hash == lower(known) then return true end end end return false end
local function url_encode_filename(value) return (tostring(value or ""):gsub("([^%w%-%._~])", function(character) return string.format("%%%02X", character:byte()) end)) end
local function validate_trusted_artifact(entry) local repository_id = tostring(entry.repository_id or "") local trusted = MCheck.trusted_repositories[repository_id] if type(trusted) ~= "table" then return nil, "untrusted repository " .. repository_id end
local artifact_type = lower(entry.artifact_type or "xml") if artifact_type ~= trusted.artifact_type then return nil, "repository/artifact type mismatch for " .. tostring(entry.id or "") end
local package_name = tostring(entry.package_name or "") local filename = tostring(entry.filename or "") local extension = artifact_type == "mpackage" and ".mpackage" or ".xml" if filename ~= package_name .. extension or basename(filename) ~= filename then return nil, "repository filename/package mismatch for " .. tostring(entry.id or "") end if trusted.filename and filename ~= trusted.filename then return nil, "repository does not permit artifact " .. filename end
local expected_url = trusted.url_prefix .. url_encode_filename(filename) if tostring(entry.url or "") ~= expected_url then return nil, "untrusted download URL for " .. tostring(entry.id or "") end return artifact_type end
local function validate_manifest(manifest) if type(manifest) ~= "table" then return nil, "repository index is not an object" end if tonumber(manifest.schema) ~= 2 then return nil, "unsupported repository index schema" end if tostring(manifest.repository_id or "") ~= MCheck.repository_id then return nil, "repository identity mismatch" end if type(manifest.addons) ~= "table" then return nil, "repository index has no addons list" end local by_id = {} for _, entry in ipairs(manifest.addons) do if type(entry) ~= "table" then return nil, "repository index contains an invalid addon" end local id = tostring(entry.id or "") local package_name = tostring(entry.package_name or "") local filename = tostring(entry.filename or "") if id == "" or package_name == "" or filename == "" then return nil, "repository addon identity is incomplete" end entry.repository_id = tostring(entry.repository_id or manifest.repository_id or "") entry.artifact_type = lower(entry.artifact_type or "xml") local _, artifact_err = validate_trusted_artifact(entry) if artifact_err then return nil, artifact_err end if hard_denied(id, package_name, filename) then return nil, "repository index attempted to target MCheck" end if by_id[id] then return nil, "repository index contains duplicate addon id " .. id end if not semver_parts(entry.version) then return nil, "invalid version for " .. id end if not tostring(entry.sha256 or ""):match("^[0-9a-fA-F]+$") or #tostring(entry.sha256) ~= 64 then return nil, "invalid SHA-256 for " .. id end if entry.known_hashes ~= nil and type(entry.known_hashes) ~= "table" then return nil, "invalid known hashes for " .. id end for known_version, known_hash in pairs(entry.known_hashes or {}) do if not semver_parts(known_version) or not tostring(known_hash):match("^[0-9a-fA-F]+$") or #tostring(known_hash) ~= 64 then return nil, "invalid known hash for " .. id end end by_id[id] = entry end return by_id end
local function apply_version_status(row) local comparison = compare_versions(row.report.version, row.entry.version) if comparison == nil then row.status = "[INVALID VERSION]" elseif comparison < 0 then row.status = "[UPDATE AVAILABLE]" row.eligible = true elseif comparison == 0 then row.status = "[CURRENT]" else row.status = "[LOCAL VERSION AHEAD]" end end
local function apply_hash_status(row, hash) row.local_sha256 = hash row.local_clean = known_official_hash(row.entry, hash) if not row.local_clean then row.status = "[LOCAL MODIFIED]" else apply_version_status(row) end end
local function build_rows_async(manifest_by_id, done) local rows, ids = {}, {} for id in pairs(MCheck.scan.responses) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end table.sort(ids) local active_scan = MCheck.scan local position = 0 local total = #ids
if total > 0 then out("light_grey", string.format("Found %d compatible installed add-on%s. Comparing one at a time...", total, total == 1 and "" or "s")) end
local function next_row() if MCheck.scan ~= active_scan then return end position = position + 1 local id = ids[position] if not id then if total > 0 then out("green", string.format("Progress %d/%d: comparison complete.", total, total)) end done(rows) return end scan_progress(position, total, id) local report = MCheck.scan.responses[id] local entry = manifest_by_id[id] local row = { addon_id = id, report = report, entry = entry, installed_version = report.version, source_path = report.source_path, status = "[NOT IN INDEX]", eligible = false, local_clean = false, } if entry then if report.repository_id ~= tostring(entry.repository_id) or report.package_name ~= tostring(entry.package_name) or report.filename ~= tostring(entry.filename) then row.status = "[IDENTITY MISMATCH]" elseif not package_is_installed(report.package_name) then row.status = "[NOT INSTALLED]" elseif entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" then row.remote_only = true apply_version_status(row) elseif report.source_path == "" then row.status = "[PATH UNKNOWN]" elseif basename(report.source_path) ~= report.filename then row.status = "[PATH IDENTITY MISMATCH]" else local bytes = read_file(report.source_path) if not bytes then row.status = "[LOCAL FILE MISSING]" else MCheck.sha256_async(bytes, function(hash) if MCheck.scan ~= active_scan then return end apply_hash_status(row, hash) rows[#rows + 1] = row next_row() end) return end end end rows[#rows + 1] = row next_row() end next_row() end
local function print_rows() if #MCheck.rows == 0 then out("orange", "No compatible installed add-ons answered the scan.") return end out("cyan", "Installed add-ons:") for index, row in ipairs(MCheck.rows) do local available = row.entry and tostring(row.entry.version) or "--" status_line(index, row, available) end command_hint("Accept one update with", "mcheck update <number>") command_hint("Force one exact row with", "mcheck update <number> force") end
function MCheck.scan_now() if MCheck.transaction or MCheck.scan then out("orange", "MCheck is already busy.") return end local scan_id = fresh_id("scan") MCheck.rows = {} MCheck.scan = { id = scan_id, responses = {}, request_url = nil } out("cyan", "Interrogating compatible installed add-ons...") raiseEvent("mcheck.scan.request", scan_id, MCheck.protocol, "") local request_url = MCheck.index_url .. "?mcheck=" .. tostring(os.time()) MCheck.scan.request_url = request_url local ok, result = pcall(getHTTP, request_url, { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache" }) if not ok or result == false then MCheck.scan = nil out("red", "Could not request the repository index: " .. tostring(result)) else start_timer(30, function() if MCheck.scan and MCheck.scan.request_url == request_url then MCheck.scan = nil out("red", "Repository index request timed out.") end end) end end
function MCheck.abort_scan() if not MCheck.scan then out("orange", "No scan is active.") return end stop_timer() cancel_hash_job() MCheck.scan = nil MCheck.rows = {} MCheck.last_scan = nil out("green", "Scan aborted.") end
function MCheck.on_scan_response(scan_id, protocol, addon_id, package_name, version, repository_id, filename, source_path) local report = { protocol = tostring(protocol or ""), addon_id = tostring(addon_id or ""), package_name = tostring(package_name or ""), version = tostring(version or ""), repository_id = tostring(repository_id or ""), filename = tostring(filename or ""), source_path = tostring(source_path or ""), } if report.protocol ~= MCheck.protocol or report.addon_id == "" then return end if hard_denied(report.addon_id, report.package_name, report.filename) then return end local transaction = MCheck.transaction if transaction and tostring(scan_id) == tostring(transaction.verify_scan_id) then if report.addon_id == transaction.row.addon_id then transaction.verify_report = report end return end if not MCheck.scan or tostring(scan_id) ~= tostring(MCheck.scan.id) then return end if not MCheck.scan.responses[report.addon_id] then MCheck.scan.responses[report.addon_id] = report end end
function MCheck.on_http_done(url, body) if not MCheck.scan or tostring(url) ~= tostring(MCheck.scan.request_url) then return end stop_timer() local ok, manifest = pcall(yajl.to_value, body) if not ok then MCheck.scan = nil out("red", "Repository index is not valid JSON: " .. tostring(manifest)) return end local by_id, err = validate_manifest(manifest) if not by_id then MCheck.scan = nil out("red", "Rejected repository index: " .. tostring(err)) return end MCheck.scan.manifest = manifest MCheck.scan.manifest_by_id = by_id MCheck.scan.phase = "hashing" out("light_grey", "Checking local add-on files in small background slices...") build_rows_async(by_id, function(rows) local completed = MCheck.scan if not completed then return end MCheck.rows = rows MCheck.scan = nil MCheck.last_scan = completed print_rows() end) end
function MCheck.on_http_error(error_message, url) if not MCheck.scan or tostring(url) ~= tostring(MCheck.scan.request_url) then return end stop_timer() MCheck.scan = nil out("red", "Repository index request failed: " .. tostring(error_message)) end
local function cleanup_transaction_files(transaction, keep_swap) if not transaction then return end if transaction.stage_path then pcall(os.remove, transaction.stage_path) end if transaction.new_path then pcall(os.remove, transaction.new_path) end if transaction.swap_path and not keep_swap then pcall(os.remove, transaction.swap_path) end end
local function continue_queue() if not MCheck.update_queue then return end local next_row = table.remove(MCheck.update_queue, 1) if not next_row then MCheck.update_queue = nil out("cyan", "Queued updates finished. Run 'mcheck scan' to refresh the list.") return end MCheck.start_update(next_row, false, true) end
local function finish_without_rollback(message, color) local transaction = MCheck.transaction stop_timer() cancel_hash_job() cleanup_transaction_files(transaction, false) MCheck.transaction = nil out(color or "red", message) if MCheck.update_queue then if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, continue_queue) else continue_queue() end end end
local function finish_remote_package_failure(message) local transaction = MCheck.transaction stop_timer() cancel_hash_job() local recovery_path = transaction and transaction.stage_path or nil if transaction then transaction.stage_path = nil end cleanup_transaction_files(transaction, false) MCheck.transaction = nil out("red", tostring(message)) if recovery_path then out("orange", "The SHA-verified repository package was kept for manual recovery: " .. tostring(recovery_path)) end if MCheck.update_queue then if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, continue_queue) else continue_queue() end end end
local function verify_identity(report, transaction, expected_version) if type(report) ~= "table" then return false, "the installed add-on did not answer verification" end local row, entry = transaction.row, transaction.row.entry if report.addon_id ~= row.addon_id or report.package_name ~= entry.package_name or report.repository_id ~= entry.repository_id or report.filename ~= entry.filename then return false, "the installed add-on reported a different identity" end if report.version ~= expected_version then return false, "the installed add-on reported version " .. report.version end if entry.artifact_type ~= "mpackage" and path_key(report.source_path) ~= path_key(row.source_path) then return false, "the installed add-on reported a different source path" end return true end
function MCheck.finish_success() local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction then return end stop_timer() cleanup_transaction_files(transaction, false) MCheck.transaction = nil if transaction.row.entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" then out("green", string.format("Reinstalled %s at repository version %s from its trusted remote package.", transaction.row.addon_id, transaction.row.entry.version)) else out("green", string.format("Reinstalled %s at repository version %s. Backup: %s", transaction.row.addon_id, transaction.row.entry.version, transaction.backup_path)) end out("light_grey", "Run 'mcheck scan' to refresh versions and modification tags.") if MCheck.update_queue then if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, continue_queue) else continue_queue() end end end
function MCheck.verify_install() local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction or transaction.phase ~= "waiting_verify" then return end transaction.verify_scan_id = fresh_id("verify") transaction.verify_report = nil raiseEvent("mcheck.scan.request", transaction.verify_scan_id, MCheck.protocol, transaction.row.addon_id) local ok, err = verify_identity(transaction.verify_report, transaction, transaction.row.entry.version) if ok then MCheck.finish_success() else MCheck.rollback("Verification failed: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function MCheck.finish_rollback() local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction then return end transaction.verify_scan_id = fresh_id("rollback") transaction.verify_report = nil raiseEvent("mcheck.scan.request", transaction.verify_scan_id, MCheck.protocol, transaction.row.addon_id) local ok, err = verify_identity(transaction.verify_report, transaction, transaction.row.installed_version) stop_timer() cleanup_transaction_files(transaction, not ok) MCheck.transaction = nil if ok then out("orange", transaction.failure_reason .. " Previous version restored from backup: " .. transaction.backup_path) else out("red", transaction.failure_reason .. " Automatic rollback could not be verified: " .. tostring(err)) out("red", "Recovery copy: " .. tostring(transaction.backup_path)) end if MCheck.update_queue then if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, continue_queue) else continue_queue() end end end
function MCheck.rollback(reason) local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction or transaction.rolling_back then return end if transaction.row.entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" then finish_remote_package_failure(tostring(reason or "Package update failed.")) return end transaction.rolling_back = true transaction.failure_reason = tostring(reason or "Update failed.") stop_timer() if package_is_installed(transaction.row.report.package_name) then pcall(uninstallPackage, transaction.row.report.package_name) end pcall(os.remove, transaction.row.source_path) local restored = transaction.swap_path and os.rename(transaction.swap_path, transaction.row.source_path) if not restored and transaction.old_bytes then restored = write_file(transaction.row.source_path, transaction.old_bytes) end if not restored then finish_without_rollback(transaction.failure_reason .. " Could not restore the original artifact. Recovery copy: " .. tostring(transaction.backup_path), "red") return end transaction.phase = "waiting_rollback_install" local ok, result = pcall(installPackage, transaction.row.source_path) if not ok or result == false then finish_without_rollback(transaction.failure_reason .. " Restored the artifact but could not reinstall it. Recovery copy: " .. tostring(transaction.backup_path), "red") return end start_timer(12, function() if MCheck.transaction and MCheck.transaction.phase == "waiting_rollback_install" then finish_without_rollback(MCheck.transaction.failure_reason .. " Rollback installation timed out. Recovery copy: " .. tostring(MCheck.transaction.backup_path), "red") end end) end
local function atomic_place_new(transaction, new_bytes) local source_path = transaction.row.source_path transaction.new_path = source_path .. ".mcheck-new" transaction.swap_path = source_path .. ".mcheck-old" pcall(os.remove, transaction.new_path) pcall(os.remove, transaction.swap_path) local ok, err = write_file(transaction.new_path, new_bytes) if not ok then return false, "could not write adjacent update file: " .. tostring(err) end local moved_old, move_err = os.rename(source_path, transaction.swap_path) if not moved_old then return false, "could not move the current artifact aside: " .. tostring(move_err) end local moved_new, new_err = os.rename(transaction.new_path, source_path) if not moved_new then pcall(os.rename, transaction.swap_path, source_path) return false, "could not place the new artifact: " .. tostring(new_err) end return true end
local function install_downloaded_artifact(transaction, new_bytes, actual_hash) if MCheck.transaction ~= transaction or transaction.phase ~= "hashing_download" then return end if lower(actual_hash) ~= lower(transaction.row.entry.sha256) then finish_without_rollback("Downloaded artifact failed SHA-256 validation; nothing was uninstalled.") return end local is_remote_package = transaction.row.entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" if is_remote_package then transaction.install_path = transaction.stage_path else local old_bytes, old_err = read_file(transaction.row.source_path) if not old_bytes then finish_without_rollback("Could not read current artifact for backup: " .. tostring(old_err)); return end transaction.old_bytes = old_bytes local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local backup_dir = home .. "/mcheck/backups/" .. transaction.row.addon_id .. "/" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") ensure_dir(backup_dir) transaction.backup_path = backup_dir .. "/" .. transaction.row.entry.filename local backup_ok, backup_err = write_file(transaction.backup_path, old_bytes) if not backup_ok then finish_without_rollback("Could not create backup: " .. tostring(backup_err)); return end local placed, place_err = atomic_place_new(transaction, new_bytes) if not placed then finish_without_rollback(place_err); return end transaction.install_path = transaction.row.source_path end
transaction.phase = "installing" local ok_uninstall, uninstall_result = pcall(uninstallPackage, transaction.row.report.package_name) if not ok_uninstall or uninstall_result == false then if is_remote_package then finish_remote_package_failure("Could not uninstall " .. transaction.row.addon_id .. ".") else MCheck.rollback("Could not uninstall " .. transaction.row.addon_id .. ".") end return end transaction.phase = "waiting_install" local ok_install, install_result = pcall(installPackage, transaction.install_path) if not ok_install or install_result == false then MCheck.rollback("Could not install repository artifact for " .. transaction.row.addon_id .. ".") return end start_timer(12, function() if MCheck.transaction and MCheck.transaction.phase == "waiting_install" then MCheck.rollback("Installation event timed out for " .. MCheck.transaction.row.addon_id .. ".") end end) end
function MCheck.on_download_done(local_path, used_url) local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction or transaction.phase ~= "downloading" or path_key(local_path) ~= path_key(transaction.stage_path) then return end stop_timer() local new_bytes, read_err = read_file(transaction.stage_path) if not new_bytes then finish_without_rollback("Could not read downloaded artifact: " .. tostring(read_err)); return end local artifact_type = tostring(transaction.row.entry.artifact_type or "xml") if artifact_type == "xml" and not new_bytes:find("<MudletPackage", 1, true) then finish_without_rollback("Downloaded file is not a Mudlet XML package.") return elseif artifact_type == "mpackage" then local signature = new_bytes:sub(1, 4) if signature ~= "PK\003\004" and signature ~= "PK\005\006" and signature ~= "PK\007\008" then finish_without_rollback("Downloaded file is not a Mudlet mpackage archive.") return end end transaction.phase = "hashing_download" out("light_grey", "Validating the downloaded artifact...") MCheck.sha256_async(new_bytes, function(actual_hash) install_downloaded_artifact(transaction, new_bytes, actual_hash) end) end
function MCheck.on_download_error(error_message, local_path, used_url) local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction or transaction.phase ~= "downloading" then return end if tostring(local_path or "") ~= "" and path_key(local_path) ~= path_key(transaction.stage_path) then return end stop_timer() finish_without_rollback("Download failed; nothing was uninstalled: " .. tostring(error_message)) end
function MCheck.on_install_event(package_name, source_path) local transaction = MCheck.transaction if not transaction or tostring(package_name) ~= tostring(transaction.row.report.package_name) then return end if transaction.row.entry.artifact_type ~= "mpackage" and path_key(source_path) ~= path_key(transaction.install_path) then return end stop_timer() if transaction.phase == "waiting_install" then transaction.phase = "waiting_verify" if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, MCheck.verify_install) else MCheck.verify_install() end elseif transaction.phase == "waiting_rollback_install" then transaction.phase = "waiting_rollback_verify" if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.1, MCheck.finish_rollback) else MCheck.finish_rollback() end end end
function MCheck.on_uninstall_event(package_name) if lower(package_name) == lower(MCheck.package_name) then MCheck.shutdown() end end
local function begin_download(transaction) if MCheck.transaction ~= transaction then return end local row = transaction.row local _, trusted_err = validate_trusted_artifact(row.entry) if trusted_err then finish_without_rollback("Download blocked: " .. tostring(trusted_err)) return end local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local stage_dir = home .. "/mcheck/staging/" .. fresh_id(row.addon_id) ensure_dir(stage_dir) transaction.stage_path = stage_dir .. "/" .. row.entry.filename transaction.phase = "downloading" pcall(os.remove, transaction.stage_path) out("cyan", string.format("Downloading %s %s%s...", row.addon_id, row.entry.version, transaction.force and " (forced reinstall)" or "")) local separator = row.entry.url:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?" local download_url = row.entry.url .. separator .. "mcheck=" .. tostring(os.time()) transaction.download_url = download_url local ok, result = pcall(downloadFile, transaction.stage_path, download_url) if not ok or result == false then finish_without_rollback("Could not start download: " .. tostring(result)) else start_timer(60, function() if MCheck.transaction and MCheck.transaction.phase == "downloading" then finish_without_rollback("Download timed out; nothing was uninstalled.") end end) end end
function MCheck.start_update(row, force, queued) if MCheck.transaction then out("orange", "An update is already running."); return end if type(row) ~= "table" or type(row.entry) ~= "table" then out("red", "That row is not in the repository index."); return end if hard_denied(row.addon_id, row.report.package_name, row.entry.filename) then out("red", "MCheck is protected and cannot target itself."); return end local _, trusted_err = validate_trusted_artifact(row.entry) if trusted_err then out("red", "The row has an untrusted update source: " .. tostring(trusted_err)); return end if row.addon_id ~= tostring(row.entry.id) or row.report.repository_id ~= tostring(row.entry.repository_id) or row.report.package_name ~= tostring(row.entry.package_name) or row.report.filename ~= tostring(row.entry.filename) then out("red", "The row's repository, package, or filename identity does not match; force cannot bypass identity checks.") return end if not force and not row.eligible then out("orange", "That row does not have an eligible normal update. Use force only if you intend to reinstall this exact row.") return end if not package_is_installed(row.report.package_name) then out("red", "The selected package is no longer installed."); return end
local transaction = { row = row, force = force == true, queued = queued == true, phase = row.entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" and "ready_to_download" or "hashing_preflight", } MCheck.transaction = transaction if row.entry.artifact_type == "mpackage" then begin_download(transaction) return end if row.source_path == "" or basename(row.source_path) ~= row.entry.filename then finish_without_rollback("The row has no safe reinstall path.") return end local current_bytes = read_file(row.source_path) if not current_bytes then finish_without_rollback("The current artifact is missing; update stopped because rollback would be impossible.") return end out("light_grey", "Verifying the selected local artifact...") MCheck.sha256_async(current_bytes, function(current_hash) if MCheck.transaction ~= transaction or transaction.phase ~= "hashing_preflight" then return end if lower(current_hash) ~= lower(row.local_sha256 or "") then finish_without_rollback("The local artifact changed after the scan. Run 'mcheck scan' again.") return end if not package_is_installed(row.report.package_name) then finish_without_rollback("The selected package is no longer installed.") return end begin_download(transaction) end) end
local function update_one(index, force) if not MCheck.last_scan or #MCheck.rows == 0 then out("orange", "Run 'mcheck scan' first."); return end local row = MCheck.rows[index] if not row then out("orange", "There is no row " .. tostring(index) .. "."); return end MCheck.start_update(row, force, false) end
local function update_all() if not MCheck.last_scan or #MCheck.rows == 0 then out("orange", "Run 'mcheck scan' first."); return end if MCheck.transaction or MCheck.update_queue then out("orange", "MCheck is already busy."); return end local queue = {} for _, row in ipairs(MCheck.rows) do if row.eligible then queue[#queue + 1] = row end end if #queue == 0 then out("orange", "No normal updates are eligible."); return end MCheck.update_queue = queue out("cyan", "Queued " .. tostring(#queue) .. " eligible update(s).") continue_queue() end
local function help() out("cyan", "Commands:") command_hint("Scan installed add-ons", "mcheck scan") command_hint("Abort the active scan", "mcheck abort") command_hint("Accept one update", "mcheck update <number>") command_hint("Force one exact row", "mcheck update <number> force") command_hint("Accept every eligible update", "mcheck update all") out("orange", "Force is intentionally limited to one numbered row; 'all force', lists, and ranges are rejected.") end
function MCheck.command(raw) raw = trim(raw) local words = {} for word in raw:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = word end if #words == 1 and lower(words[1]) == "scan" then MCheck.scan_now(); return end if (#words == 1 and lower(words[1]) == "abort") or (#words == 2 and lower(words[1]) == "scan" and lower(words[2]) == "abort") then MCheck.abort_scan() return end if #words >= 2 and lower(words[1]) == "update" then if lower(words[2]) == "all" then if #words ~= 2 then out("red", "Forced or qualified all-updates are not allowed."); return end update_all(); return end if not words[2]:match("^%d+$") then out("red", "Update requires one row number."); return end local force = #words == 3 and lower(words[3]) == "force" if #words > 3 or (#words == 3 and not force) then out("red", "Use exactly: mcheck update <number> [force]"); return end update_one(tonumber(words[2]), force) return end help() end
function MCheck.route_event(event_name, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h) if event_name == "mcheck.scan.response" then MCheck.on_scan_response(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h) elseif event_name == "sysGetHttpDone" then MCheck.on_http_done(a,b) elseif event_name == "sysGetHttpError" then MCheck.on_http_error(a,b) elseif event_name == "sysDownloadDone" then MCheck.on_download_done(a,b) elseif event_name == "sysDownloadError" then MCheck.on_download_error(a,b,c) elseif event_name == "sysInstallPackage" then MCheck.on_install_event(a,b) elseif event_name == "sysUninstallPackage" then MCheck.on_uninstall_event(a) end end
function MCheck.shutdown() stop_timer() cancel_hash_job() MCheck.scan = nil MCheck.transaction = nil MCheck.update_queue = nil end
math.randomseed(os.time() + math.floor((os.clock() or 0) * 100000)) out("green", "Loaded v" .. MCheck.version .. ". Use 'mcheck scan' to check installed add-ons.")

Script.name: MCheckEventRouter
Script.script: function MCheckEventRouter(event_name, ...) if type(MCheck) == "table" and type(MCheck.route_event) == "function" then MCheck.route_event(event_name, ...) end end
